areas.title: Main Stage

maps.caption: MAIN STAGE CLUSTER / H1.* ON PLAN

areas.lighting: Moving light sequences along static ceiling strips; clean white speaker light.
areas.brief: Panoramic LED, signature strips, ceiling and side-wall scenery, VIP/audience seating and accessible stage routes.
areas.note: The brief calls the hall Hall 1A; the master plan uses stand H1.A90. Coordinate using the stand code.

areas.title: The Full Stack Stage

maps.caption: WEST HALL 2 / LABELLED HALL 2A ON PLAN

areas.lighting: Soft cyan/pink edges with even screen and speaker lighting.
areas.brief: 14 x 17 m; one main LED, accessible ramp, podium, six speaker chairs, mixed audience seating and production desks.

areas.title: Investor & Founder Stage
areas.lighting: Clear faces and presentation content; restrained perimeter accents.
areas.brief: 24 x 15 m; one main LED, raised stage, ramp, lectern, six speaker chairs and mixed seating.

areas.title: LEAP Forward Stage
areas.lighting: Ground-supported light profiles; direct speaker wash, subtle cyan/pink.
areas.brief: 15 x 22 m; one main LED, podium, accessible ramp, mixed audience furniture and production area.

areas.title: Rocket Fuel Stage
areas.lighting: Founder spotlight, programmable launch-energy lines, no real flame effect.
areas.brief: Panel stage and diamond pitch platform, judges desk, hero entrance, check-in, accessible ramp, one main LED and mixed seating.

areas.title: Announcement Stages
areas.lighting: Even signing-table and speaker lighting, controlled scenic glow.
areas.brief: One modular family for two sizes: 15 x 14 m and 15 x 12 m. Signing table, main screen, podium, ramp and audience seating.
areas.note: Same concept reference applies to both locations; resize to each footprint.

areas.title: Premium Lounges
areas.lighting: Warm-white seating light with fine cyan/pink edges; avoid many glowing columns.
areas.brief: One premium family across three footprints: illuminated portal, mixed seating, networking clusters, lettering, coffee bar and low dividers.
areas.note: Graphite carpet remains the main lounge flooring; LVT is a selected premium inlay.

areas.title: LEAP Lounge
areas.lighting: Comfortable warm-white light, small cyan/pink perimeter highlights.
areas.brief: 13 x 21 m open lounge with mixed seating, meeting clusters, LEAP lettering, coffee bar and low acoustic/translucent dividers.

areas.title: Speakers Lounge
areas.lighting: Warm-white hospitality lighting with selective facade LED and LEAP accents.
areas.brief: 15 x 11 m double-deck lounge; stairs, glass balustrade, registration, LED facade, catering counter, photo wall, screens and planting.
areas.note: Concept shows the design language; the double-deck structure needs its own detailed development.

areas.title: Green Rooms
areas.lighting: Flattering mirror and task light, calm warm-white ambient light; hidden cables.
areas.brief: Enclosed speaker preparation rooms: seating, screened make-up area, mirrors, garment storage, catering counter and stage-feed TVs.
areas.note: Image illustrates the 60 m² room. Adapt furniture and quantities to the 18 m² room.

areas.title: Investors Lounge + Matchmaking
areas.lighting: Good face-to-face meeting light, subtle brand accents, quiet LP lounge mood.
areas.brief: Shared entry and registration; removable divide, meeting rooms/pods, catering, tables and charging. LP area of about 45 m² is inside Investors Lounge.
areas.note: The two footprints total 850 m²; brief header says 580 m². Use the individual labelled areas for review.

areas.title: Private Dining
areas.lighting: Warm-white dining and buffet light; discreet cyan/pink detailing.
areas.brief: 26 x 17 m, 150 seats; brandable sun walls on two sides, portal, mixed furniture, coffee bar and catering counters.
areas.note: Plan shows the access position. The upper-level room is not drawn in the supplied master plan; graphite carpet is the main floor finish.

areas.title: Coworking Stations
areas.lighting: Good warm-white task light at every work position; subtle LEAP edge detail.
areas.brief: Work tables, benches, chairs/stools, sockets/USB, lockers, plants and space/power for organiser-provided meeting pods.
areas.note: Three locations are listed. H2.H50 dimensions give 80 m² but the brief says 40 m²; confirm before layout.

areas.title: Media Hub
areas.lighting: Even neutral interview lighting and practical desk light; minimal coloured spill.
areas.brief: Working journalist lounge with desks, power and lighting; 14 interview stands with two chairs, coffee table, magazine rack and backdrop each.
areas.note: Respect the 3.5 m ceiling and nearby 2.9 m low zone. Booth area excludes circulation.

areas.title: LEAP Connect
areas.lighting: Layered warm-white hospitality lighting with a short digital arrival tunnel and LED accents.
areas.brief: 30 x 15 m; stage with 8 x 3 m LED, digital tunnel, registration, bar, food counters, VIP lounge, DJ/photo booths and back-of-house.

areas.title: Merch Store
areas.lighting: Track display lighting and discreet counter/header LEDs.
areas.brief: 8 x 6 m; four closed sides, front serving counters, merchandise display, bilingual lit header, TV and lockable stock storage.

areas.title: Indoor F&B Kiosks

maps.caption: VENUE-WIDE / NEARBY KIOSKS GROUPED AS PINS

areas.lighting: Clear menu/food lighting, illuminated counter fronts and vertical light lines.
areas.brief: One kiosk family scaled to 13 locations, with branded service counters, storage, backwalls, digital menus, clear queues and seating.
areas.note: Listed footprints total 915 m²; the brief header says 815 m². Food operations/equipment are by others.

areas.title: Food Festival + Outdoor F&B
areas.lighting: Warm evening light, subtle brand details; shade and misting over queues, seating and kiosks.
areas.brief: 17 food-truck bays, 7 outdoor kiosks, dining/chill/game zones, entrance arches, photo landmark, planting and wayfinding.
areas.note: *C.A20 measures 120 x 60 m on plan (= 7,200 m²); the brief says 17,000 m². Confirm both plaza extents before detailed design.
areas.source: Food Festival + Outdoor F&B brief pp.3,13-16

areas.title: Future Mobility Zone
areas.lighting: Vehicle feature lighting, luminous ring canopies and low-glare platform edges.
areas.brief: 16 x 27 m; six circular pods in three pairs, light-ring canopies, curved LED/lightbox backdrops, entrance arch, desk and vehicle access.
areas.note: Pod IDs H5.A20-A25 are used inside zone H3.A10 in the client brief.

areas.title: Open Vista
areas.lighting: Soft internal sculpture light with cyan/pink gradients and calm seating light.
areas.brief: 15 x 26 m; original central landmark, open seating clusters, planting, charging, photo space and LEAP floor graphics.
areas.note: An original 2027 concept: do not reproduce the 2025 tree or the 2026 numeral 5. Carpet remains the principal area finish.

areas.title: Hall 3 Seating + Photo Areas

maps.caption: HALL 3 / MATCHING CORNERS ACROSS THE AISLE

areas.lighting: Lit LEAP letters, restrained furniture accents and comfortable ambient light.
areas.brief: Two triangular/curved-edge seating corners; soft seating, one lit 3D LEAP logo each, photo markers, removable floor graphics, charging and planting.

areas.title: Tunnels

maps.caption: FOUR HALL LINKS / FOLLOW FLOW ARROWS

areas.lighting: Diffused dimmable portals, smooth transitions from hall light levels, no eye-level glare.
areas.brief: Five treatments: four hall links plus Gate A-13. Brand walls/headers, floors, ceiling elements and directional signs; doors/exits remain clear.
areas.note: Hall-link sizes are approximate from the brief: T1 5 x 37 m; T2 5 x 35 m; T3 5 x 40 m; T4 8 x 41 m.

materials.name: BLACK POWDER-COATED ALUMINIUM
materials.spec: Reusable aluminium profiles / fabricated faces in matte charcoal. Match the LEAP black finish sample.

materials.name: BRUSHED / ANODIZED ALUMINIUM
materials.spec: Silver brushed-look or anodized trim and scenic profiles. Confirm the finish sample and forming method.

materials.name: TRANSLUCENT POLYCARBONATE
materials.spec: Opal, frosted or textured sheet. Use a stocked flat-sheet grade if the ribbed look needs a custom lead time.

materials.name: PROCESSED SAFETY GLASS
materials.spec: Local tempered / laminated fabrication. Balustrade grade, thickness and fixings are application-specific.

materials.name: GRAPHITE EVENT CARPET
materials.spec: Charcoal exhibition roll carpet or reusable contract carpet. Request the organiser-required fire documentation.
materials.short: UAE stockist / KSA supply Al Samiah [S06]

materials.name: CONTRACT UPHOLSTERY FABRIC
materials.spec: Grey woven upholstery from the local range. Confirm wear performance and the required fire specification.

materials.name: CHARCOAL LVT / VINYL
materials.spec: Commercial interior LVT or sheet vinyl in a charcoal stone-look finish. Select the exact stocked range locally.

materials.name: HPL-FACED JOINERY
materials.spec: Charcoal HPL on an appropriate joinery substrate. Replaces a generic compact-laminate assumption with a locally supplied laminate finish.

materials.name: FSC PLYWOOD / SCENIC BOARD
materials.spec: Request FSC-certified timber/plywood and the required fire-rated or treated assembly. Specific certified batches remain an RFQ item.

materials.name: ARCHITECTURAL SHADE MEMBRANE
materials.spec: Locally supplied coated technical shade fabric. Confirm canopy grade, colour and structural fabrication with the fabric supplier.

materials.name: OUTDOOR FABRIC + CUSHIONS
materials.spec: Weather-resistant contract upholstery or complete outdoor cushions. Saudi source verifies a furniture/cushion route, not bulk fabric meterage.

materials.name: OUTDOOR PORCELAIN PAVING
materials.spec: Dark textured exterior porcelain or pavers. Check slip grade and temporary-installation build-up before selection.

materials.name: DIFFUSED LINEAR LED
materials.spec: Opal diffused linear profiles / neon flex. Select RGBW or pixel systems where programmed LEAP accents are needed.

materials.name: PRINTABLE FABRIC / MEDIA
materials.spec: Local polyester print media with official LEAP artwork. The exact fabric fire certificate and print finish need confirmation.

materials.name: LOCAL PLANTING + PLANTERS
materials.spec: Locally sourced planting with fabricated powder-coated planters. Choose species for indoor light or outdoor exposure as appropriate.
materials.short: UAE Desert Group / KSA Desert Views [S24-25]
